scope: fresh edition publication, source and watchlist discovery, independent live QA and owner-only operations
resource_policy: Plus Work/Codex allowance and built-in premium image generation only; no paid API, added credits, overage, top-up, upgrade or alternate account

failed_attempts.evidence: The local bundle executable was unavailable. Candidate and production GitHub CI completed the deterministic Jekyll build successfully before success was reported.
Two inherited fixtures assumed a future date that became current and a multi-evidence watchlist topic. The fixtures were made date- and evidence-independent; all 109 tests pass.
Thirty-five of 49 registered watchlist sources returned candidate links; eight require assisted review, three returned no candidate links and three were unavailable.

Independent command-line probes returned 403 for Microsoft and timed out for Google Cloud, while their normalized official links and previously reviewed primary evidence remain intact. No false availability claim was made.

usage.reason: The platform did not provide edition-attributed credit or dollar data. Drafts, rejects and elapsed time were measured and saved privately.
